chunks: Then you, the erring and the deniers,

key_terms.الضَّالُّونَ: The erring / those who have gone astray
key_terms.المُكَذِّبُونَ: The deniers / those who rejected the truth

ai.seo_question: Who are the 'erring and deniers' mentioned in Surah Al-Infitar?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Infitar, this verse serves as a direct address to the Meccan polytheists, emphasizing their active role in misguidance (ḍalāl) and their deliberate rejection (takdhīb) of the divine signs. Shia exegetes often highlight this dual state as a precursor to the severe reckoning described in the subsequent verses, illustrating how denial leads to spiritual blindness.
